verdict.rationale: Entity-choice and incorporation-jurisdiction guidance is a fair question for an international law firm, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack addresses it. The TwoVenture hub offers general start-up guidance across the VC life cycle (Start & Seed, Scale & Growth, Exit & Beyond), but no item mentions entity types or choosing where to incorporate (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd). The other items cover term sheets, VC deals, IP and privacy, not formation.
